title: US Marine Corps Physical Fitness Test (PFT)
creator: US Marine Corps
description: The twice-yearly Marine PFT: maximum dead-hang pull-ups (or push-ups in two minutes, capped at 70 of the 100 points), a maximum plank hold, and a 3-mile run. Each event scores up to 100 points; the plank maxes out at 3:45 and passes at 1:10, and 18:00 for the run is 100 points for the youngest men. Events are done in this order on the same day.
